label: ElevenLabs
terms_note: API on every plan incl. Free; Free output is NON-commercial + attribution, paid plans grant perpetual commercial rights (no resale of raw output; OEM terms for bundling); concurrency per plan (Multilingual v2: Free 2 / Starter 3 / Creator 5 / Pro 10 / Scale+Business 15; Flash 4/6/10/20/30; Music 0/2/2/2/5); credits billed per character / per generation

auth: 1. Tenant signs up at elevenlabs.io (Free plan works for the API; commercial output needs a paid plan — see Terms).
2. Profile → **API Keys** → create a key (scoped keys are available; needs at least text-to-speech / sound-generation / music / dubbing / voices scopes for the functions below).
3. Every request: header `xi-api-key: <key>`. Keys do not expire; the tenant revokes them in the dashboard.
4. Hosted MCP (`https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp`): **OAuth**, the user authorises the workspace in the browser; no key copied. Regional MCP urls exist for EU / IN / SG.

endpoints.purpose: plan, character quota, concurrency tier — the connect/verify probe

reference.limits: Concurrency is a **plan** attribute (docs/models table): Multilingual v2 — Free 2 · Starter 3 · Creator 5 · Pro 10 · Scale/Business 15; Flash/Turbo — 4 · 6 · 10 · 20 · 30; STT 8 · 12 · 20 · 40 · 60; Music **0 on Free**, 2 on Starter–Pro, 5 on Scale/Business; Enterprise elevated. Over-limit → HTTP 429 (`too_many_concurrent_requests`) — back off, do not retry hot. Credits: TTS 1 credit / character (Flash 0.5), SFX / music billed per generation; the `character-cost` header is authoritative. - Free plan: **non-commercial only** and attribution (“elevenlabs.io”/“11.ai”) required when publishing. P
mcp_sdk: Hosted official MCP: `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp` (OAuth; agents CRUD + speech generation + cost estimates; regional variants EU/IN/SG). Docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/operate/hosted-mcp

Local official MCP (archived 2026-08-20, still installable): `uvx elevenlabs-mcp` with `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` — TTS, STS, SFX, music (+ inpainting, video-to-music), STT, isolation, voice design. https://github.com/elevenlabs/elevenlabs-mcp ; Smithery `@elevenlabs/elevenlabs-mcp`.

SDKs: Python `pip install elevenlabs` (https://github.com/elevenlabs/elevenlabs-python), Node `@elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js` (https://github.com/elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js), browser `@elevenlabs/client`, React `@elevenlabs/react`.
ElevenLabs Agents can also *consume* our MCP servers (SSE / streamable HTTP, secret-token header, per-tool approval) — relevant if an `ai_agent` build is exported as an ElevenLabs voice agent.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: ElevenLabs API key (Profile > API Keys; scoped keys need voices read/write for these tools), sent as the xi-api-key header.

adapter.terms: Free plan output is non-commercial and requires attribution; commercial use needs a paid plan (elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use).

me.note: GET /v1/user: user id, subscription tier, character count/limit.

list_items.note: GET /v2/voices?page_size (≤100)&next_page_token&search&voice_type: the account's voices (items are voices; collection = voice_type such as personal, community, default, workspace). Cursor-paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

get_item.note: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}: one voice with its settings, labels and samples (in raw).

delete_item.note: DELETE /v1/voices/{voice_id} -> {status: ok}: permanently deletes a voice the account owns.

not_offered.generate_image: ElevenLabs is an audio platform; it has no image generation endpoint.
not_offered.generate_video: No video generation endpoint (dubbing POST /v1/dubbing takes a multipart file or source_url and returns audio/video bytes per language).
not_offered.get_job: Speech, sound-effect and music generation are synchronous and answer with audio bytes ('Returns audio file', https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert), which a JSON tool result cannot carry; there is no job/URL variant for them.
not_offered.create_item: Voices are created with multipart uploads of audio samples (POST /v1/voices/add, 'multipart/form-data', https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/voices/ivc/create); multipart request bodies are not supported by the runtime.
not_offered.update_item: POST /v1/voices/{voice_id}/edit is multipart/form-data ('This endpoint expects a multipart form with multiple files', https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/voices/edit); multipart request bodies are not supported by the runtime.

evidence: host api.elevenlabs.io: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
